diagnosis: Working diagnosis: NSTEMI / NSTE-ACS with suspected LCx/obtuse marginal culprit lesion. The final clinical diagnosis must consider competing causes and the complete record.
risk_assessment: Moderate / high-risk teaching tier; not a formal validated risk score.

investigation_reports.ecg: Dynamic lateral ST-segment depression and T-wave inversion in the synthetic ECG series.
investigation_reports.serial_troponin: Serial high-sensitivity troponin shows a rise above the fictional assay-specific 99th percentile; pattern is consistent with acute myocardial injury in this scenario.
investigation_reports.echo: Mild inferolateral hypokinesis; estimated LVEF 50% in this synthetic report.
investigation_reports.angiography: Illustrative report: left circumflex (LCx) obtuse marginal branch with a focal approximately 90% stenosis and impaired flow before simulated treatment; LAD has non-obstructive disease and RCA has moderate non-culprit disease. Anatomy and values are fictional.

pathway_review.label: Urgent specialist assessment and inpatient invasive strategy consideration
supports: Dynamic ECG changes and rising troponin in the scenario
pathway_review.reason: The 2025 ACC/AHA ACS guideline recommends an invasive approach during hospitalization for intermediate/high-risk NSTE-ACS candidates; timing depends on instability and clinician assessment.

pathway_review.label: If anatomy, patient factors and Heart Team/clinician assessment support it, simulate culprit-lesion PCI
supports: Severe focal culprit-like lesion aligns with symptoms and injury pattern
against: Revascularization choice depends on full anatomy, contraindications and patient factors
pathway_review.reason: For learning only: compare a successful simulated PCI with alternatives; do not encode a universal device or medication recipe.

pathway_review.label: Discharge without resolving recurrent symptoms or troponin rise
against: Misses possible ACS and dynamic risk features
pathway_review.reason: Safety-critical reasoning trap. The simulation should stop progression and explain the unresolved risk.

simulated_clinical_course.on_recurrent_pain: Increase urgency level; log time and ask learner to reassess stability and escalation.
simulated_clinical_course.after_angiography: Reveal LCx/OM lesion only after learner requests the angiography report.
simulated_clinical_course.after_pathway: If a suitable revascularization path is selected, show a simulated post-treatment flow improvement and require a complication/safety check. If ignored, show recurrent ischemia in the teaching timeline.

learning_objectives: Recognize that dynamic ECG changes and troponin rise support an ACS working diagnosis.
Explain why risk stratification and inpatient invasive assessment may be appropriate.
Perform a pre-procedure safety review, including contrast-reaction history, renal function, bleeding risk and medication reconciliation.
review_note: Synthetic content requires review and approval by a qualified interventional cardiologist before educational deployment. No values are validated clinical thresholds or instructions.
